author: samuelsoria
quote: Great graphics, but it’s obvious they put absolutely no effort into it. They reused almost the exact same facial features from Red Dead Redemption 2. I understand that a game this massive can have bugs, but there are just WAY too many!With all the money they spent, couldn’t they hire a decent QA testing team?Pathetic story, boring gameplay, and nowhere near the level of GTA 5’s storyline. Extremely **** funniest part is watching how the pathetic gaming press was apparently paid to give a 99 to something that deserves an 8 at best.They’ve completely destroyed the legacy of GTA 5.What a shame.

author: samuelsoria
quote: A masterpiece. It truly achieves what it set out to do. The music alone made people cry just by hearing the intro, or during the 40th anniversary concert presentation.Coming back to play it again and realizing that this game simply doesn't age, and understanding how it laid the foundations for what 3D gaming would become, is something truly **** I can say is: **Wow, Nintendo! Thank you for the path you've paved with your games!!**
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
